messages:
olivia: heads-up — ParcelShift on dedicated pool d-ps-east is seeing repeated scale up/down churn for the past ~30m, customers reporting 429s and p50 latency spikes. attaching quick logs below.

autoscaler-bot: ALERT d-ps-east autoscaler: 6 scale events in 18m, recent pattern: UP -> DOWN -> UP -> DOWN. last decision: scale_down(reason=idle, replicas=1) at 2145000980.

sam: can you paste the autoscaler decision timeline + a short repro? also which tenant id?

olivia: tenant parcel-678. timeline (most recent):
```
2144999400 scale_up -> replicas 4 reason=queue_latency(>200ms)
2144999900 scale_down -> replicas 2 reason=idle_threshold
2145000200 scale_up -> replicas 4 reason=queue_latency(>220ms)
2145000500 scale_down -> replicas 1 reason=idle_threshold
2145000800 scale_up -> replicas 3 reason=queue_latency(>210ms)
2145000980 scale_down -> replicas 1 reason=idle_threshold
```
metrics snapshot around oscillation window:
```
- gpu_util: 38% -> 85% -> 40% (flapping)
- inflight_reqs: 2 -> 28 -> 3
- avg_queue_len: 0.1 -> 7.4 -> 0.2
- token_rate_per_sec(tenant): 90 -> 1200 -> 100
- p95 latency(ms): 120 -> 820 -> 140
```

olivia: also seeing client retries in logs, a bunch of short <1s requests burst every 2m, looks like a heartbeat-ish uploader.

marco: that pattern smells like a noisy neighbor with bursty request paterns triggering heuristic autoscale. current autoscaler config uses short smoothing window (15s) and cooldown 30s for this pool.

priya: repro steps from my side: ran a 1s-burst script targeting parcel-678 on d-ps-east (script below). I can reproduce the sawtooth within 10 minutes.
```
# repro (runs bursts every 120s)
for i in {1..30}; do
  seq 50 | xargs -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/dedicated/d-ps-east/run -d '{"tenant":"parcel-678","prompt":"short"}' &
  sleep 120
done
```

sam: nice repro. couple of immediate mitigations we can try:
- increase cooldown to 120s for d-ps-east tenant-overrides
- increase smoothing window to 120s (moving average)
- set min_replicas=2 for parcel-678 to avoid single-node collapse
- apply client-side rate limit recommendation to ParcelShift CS: prefer batching or backoff on retries

alex: i can ping the ParcelShift account team and ask them to throttle or add jitter to retries. they have a cron-ish uploader, likely ship-internal.

marco: longer-term: autoscaler should weight token_rate and request-size separately and avoid reacting to short-lived microbursts. we can also enable a per-tenant burst-token bucket that lets short bursts not tip global pool decisions.

olivia: logs also show occasional 500s from model runtime when the node switches, maybe transient cold-starts when replicas change.

sam: ok plan: 1) emergency patch — bump cooldown to 120s + smoothing to 120s + set min_replicas=2 for parcel-678 (temp). 2) test in canary pool d-canary-east. 3) if stable, roll to d-ps-east. 4) longer-term runtime changes (marco).

marco: i'll prepare a small config PR and run canary release. recommend adding a guard that prevents scaling below X if recent scale_count > 3 in 10m.

priya: quick question — do we need to change scale_down_thresholds or just cooldown/smoothing?

sam: both is safer. keep threshold but add hysteresis: require sustained idle for 90s post-smoothing before scale_down. that plus cooldown should stop the ping-pong.

olivia: customer impact: reported 429s from two customers -> CS ticket 48721 opened. alex will coordinate talking points.

alex: noted. i'll ask them to apply client-side backoff and confirm the cron schedule. will update ticket.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch fix/autoscale-hysteresis — build ok, running canary deploy to d-canary-east.

sam: assignment: sam -> push emergency config and monitor for 30m after canary deploy. marco -> PR for autoscaler smoothing + guard. olivia -> keep CS updated. alex -> contact ParcelShift. priya -> run repro script again after canary.

priya: running repro now against canary pool, will post results.

priya: after 25m on canary with new cooldown/smoothing: saw the burst but no scale-down until steady low usage. no 429s observed. p95 dropped from 820 -> 210 under same load. :thumbsup:

sam: great — schedule: roll to d-ps-east in 15m, keep monitoring + increase alert thresholds temporarily so we don't noisy-alert on controlled fluctuations.

marco: logging note: will add additional tags to autoscaler events for tenant_id + burst_signature so we can search incidents faster.

olivia: updating ticket 48721 with mitigation steps and ETA for roll.

alex: customer told me they can add random jitter to uploads this afternoon, should help long-term.

sam: leaving this thread open until 2145005850 for post-roll observations. thanks everyone, nice fast triage.

priya: post-roll note (2145005850): d-ps-east rolled, 45m stable, no repeat 429s from ParcelShift. closing for now, will reopen if churn resumes.
